# apple_submit_app_event (Action)

Submits an in-app event to App Review, by adding it to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one. The event must be a draft or rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_app_event" "summer" {
  config {
    app_id       = data.apple_app.example.id
    app_event_id = apple_app_event.summer.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_event_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app event, e.g. `apple_app_event.example.id`.
- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) Platform of the review submission: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`. Defaults to `IOS`.
- `submit` (Boolean) Whether to submit the review submission. Set it to `false` to add other items to the same submission. Defaults to `true`.
